# CONF-012: tools/list returns tools in a deterministic order

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| warn | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/server/tools#capabilities](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/tools#capabilities) |

Calls tools/list three times and compares the order of tool names. Servers SHOULD return tools in the same order while the set is unchanged. Only the first page is compared.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-012`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-012"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
